bible.narrative_arc: Hermes tries to settle a debt with Charon, who deflects payment due to low business.
bible.tempo_envelope: Fast-paced with quick exchanges, reflecting the frustration and urgency of Hermes.
key_beats: Charon acknowledges the debt but finds the price steep.
Hermes lists the items and their costs.
Charon agrees to the prices but delays payment.
Hermes expresses frustration over the lack of souls and reminisces about the past.
bible.directorial_notes: Ensure Hermes' frustration is palpable and Charon's responses are dry and transactional. The dialogue should feel like a fast-paced negotiation with comedic undertones.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> Hey Charon, let's settle up what you owe me, okay? I don't want to argue about it later.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: <emotion value="neutral"/> Sure thing, Hermes. Better to get it sorted now and avoid the hassle.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> I brought you an anchor for five drachmas.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> Swear by Hades, I paid five for it. And a pulley for two obols.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: <emotion value="neutral"/> Alright, put down five drachmas and two obols.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> And a sail patch — that was five obols.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> Plus wax to seal the boat's leaks, nails, and rope for the rigging — all that was two drachmas.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> That's everything, unless we missed something. So, when are you paying up?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> Can't do it now, Hermes. But if a plague or war sends a bunch of souls our way, I'll make a profit on the fares and pay you then.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> So I should just sit here hoping for the worst so I can get paid?

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> That's the deal, Hermes. Not many arrivals right now, as you can see — it's peacetime.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: <emotion value="nostalgic"/> Well, maybe you could extend my credit a bit. But seriously, Charon, remember the old days? All those brave souls, covered in blood and battle scars. Now it's all poisonings, overeating, and backstabbing for money. They're pale and pathetic, nothing like the old crowd.

lines.speaker: Charon
lines.text: <emotion value="nostalgic"/> Yeah, those were the days.

lines.speaker: Hermes
lines.text: <emotion value="frustrated"/> So you can't blame me for being a bit pushy about getting what's owed.

annotation.notes: Ensure Hermes' frustration is palpable and Charon's responses are dry and transactional. The dialogue should feel like a fast-paced negotiation with comedic undertones.
